libphonenumber-js 1.13.16 (MIT)
Source: https://github.com/catamphetamine/libphonenumber-js
Vendored bundle: node_modules/libphonenumber-js/bundle/libphonenumber-max.js
Full numbering-plan metadata, including fixed lines and mobiles. No remote validation requests.
To update: npm install --save-exact libphonenumber-js@<version>, copy the max bundle and LICENSE, update the script version in index.html, then run npm test.
